# Prompt for GPT
I was able to use yfinance (a Python library) to download VOO (Vanguard S&P 500 ETF) data into a CSV file. Does R have a similar library that could do the same thing? If so, how can I download the VOO data and save it into a CSV file with R?

# Download and save data

```{r}
library(tidyquant)
library(readr)
```

```{r}
voo <- tq_get("VOO", get = "stock.prices",
              from = "2016-01-01",
              to   = "2025-12-31")

# Create folder if it doesn't exist
dir.create("data", showWarnings = FALSE)

# Save to CSV
write_csv(voo, "data/voo_10y.csv")

file.exists("data/voo_10y.csv")
```
